parrafo.es: Rey's Auto Repair atiende a Little Havana desde 1988. Rey, Steven y el equipo se encargan de cambios de aceite, frenos, llantas, diagnóstico computarizado y reparación general para todo tipo de carro, desde el auto de todos los días hasta el deportivo ocasional, con precios honestos y buena comunicación.
parrafo.en: Rey's Auto Repair has served Little Havana since 1988. Rey, Steven and the crew handle oil changes, brakes, tires, computer diagnostics and general repair for all makes and models, from daily drivers to the occasional exotic, with honest pricing and clear communication.

hero.imagen_alt: Rey's Auto Repair Shop storefront with open garage bay on SW 15th Ave, Little Havana

parrafo_1.es: Rey's Auto Repair es un taller familiar en Little Havana, dirigido por Rey y su hijo Steven junto a un pequeño equipo de mecánicos. Desde 1988 mantienen en marcha los carros del barrio, trabajando desde Jeeps y Mercedes-Benz hasta camionetas Ram ProMaster y, de vez en cuando, algún Lamborghini que entra por la puerta del taller.
parrafo_1.en: Rey's Auto Repair is a family-run shop in Little Havana, led by Rey and his son Steven alongside a small crew of mechanics. Since 1988 they have kept neighborhood cars running, working on everything from Jeeps and Mercedes-Benz to Ram ProMaster vans and the occasional Lamborghini that rolls through the bay door.

parrafo_2.es: Los clientes en Google describen un taller honesto sobre lo que el carro realmente necesita, que explica el diagnóstico con claridad y hace el trabajo bien a la primera. 715 reseñas y una calificación de 4.9 lo respaldan.
parrafo_2.en: Customers on Google describe a shop that is honest about what a car actually needs, explains the diagnosis clearly and gets the job done right the first time. 715 reviews and a 4.9 rating back that up.

titulo.es: Llama o pasa por el taller

texto.es: Cuéntale a Rey o Steven qué le pasa al carro. Contestamos el teléfono directamente, sin menús ni esperas.
texto.en: Tell Rey or Steven what is going on with your car. We answer the phone directly, no menus, no long holds.

texto.es: Revisamos el carro y usamos diagnóstico computarizado cuando hace falta para encontrar el problema de verdad, no solo el síntoma.
texto.en: We inspect the car and run computer diagnostics when needed to find the real problem, not just the symptom.

titulo.en: A clear price before we start

texto.es: Te explicamos qué necesita el carro y cuánto cuesta antes de tocar una sola pieza. Sin sorpresas en la factura.
texto.en: We explain what the car needs and what it costs before we touch a single part. No surprises on the bill.

texto.es: Hacemos el trabajo bien y te avisamos apenas esté listo. Vuelves a la calle con el carro andando como debe.
texto.en: We do the job right and let you know as soon as it is ready. You are back on the road, running the way it should.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se revisa en persona y se cotiza con honestidad, sin lista de precios fija. Llámanos o pasa por el taller y te explicamos todo antes de empezar.
nota.en: Every job is looked at in person and quoted honestly, no fixed price list. Call us or stop by and we will walk you through it before any work starts.

texto.es: Diagnóstico y reparación para todo tipo de carro, nacional o importado. Lo confirman las reseñas: Jeep, Mercedes-Benz, Ram ProMaster y hasta un Lamborghini han pasado por aquí.
texto.en: Diagnosis and repair for all makes and models, domestic or import. The reviews confirm it: Jeeps, Mercedes-Benz, Ram ProMaster vans and even a Lamborghini have come through our bay.

texto.es: Cambios de aceite y fluidos para mantener tu carro andando bien, el mantenimiento básico que previene reparaciones más caras.
texto.en: Routine oil and fluid service to keep your car running well, the basic upkeep that heads off bigger, costlier repairs.

texto.es: Servicio de frenos y llantas. Un cliente cuenta que le resolvimos una llanta ponchada en menos de 20 minutos.
texto.en: Brake service and tire repair. One customer mentions we knocked out a flat tire repair in under 20 minutes.

texto.es: Diagnóstico computarizado para encontrar el problema real antes de cualquier reparación, sin adivinar ni cambiar piezas de más.
texto.en: Computer diagnostics to find the real issue before any repair, no guesswork and no swapping parts that do not need it.

pie.es: ¿No ves lo que tu carro necesita en esta lista? Llámanos igual, la mayoría de los trabajos empiezan con una llamada.
pie.en: Do not see what your car needs on this list? Call us anyway, most jobs start with a quick phone call.

items.quote: This wonderful family has been taking care of my family's cars for decades. Jeep Wrangler, Benz 500 SEL, Promaster Camper Van and Promaster City cargo. Friends and neighbors we've sent are now loyal customers too. Friendly, honest, skilled and accurate in diagnosis and repairs when needed. Rey's Auto is a valued part of the Miami Community who take pride in their work and reputation. I have trusted Rey, Steven and the mechanics completely and never once disappointed.

I had a great experience at Rey's Auto Repair Shop. The service was professional, friendly, and reliable. They took the time to address my car's needs such as oil change, tires and brake maintenance and any other repairs. It's hard to find an auto repair shop you can trust and I truly appreciate their overall approach.
Have been coming to Rey's Auto Repair shop for years. Amazing service, communication and fair pricing. Absolutely recommend their services. Knocked out a tire repair in under 20 minutes.
